Download azospirillaceae
```{bash}
cat genome_accessions | while read line;do datasets download genome accession $line; mv ncbi_dataset.zip $line\.zip;done

```

```{bash}
cat ../genome_accessions | while read line;do quast -o quast/$line --gene-finding --min-contig 500 $line\.fna;done
```

```{bash}
checkm lineage_wf --threads 40 -x fna fna/ checkm/
```

```{bash}
awk '{print $1 , $30 $32 $48}' bin_stats_ext.tsv | sed -r 's/,/\t/g' | sed -r 's/\s/\t/' > metrics
```

```{r}

filtering_data$contigs <- filtering_data$contigs |> as.numeric()

```

```{bash}
ls | while read line;do busco -i ../analysis_stage/genomes/fna/$line -l ./rhodospirillales_odb10/ -m genome -f -o final/$line\_busco -c 50;done
```

```{bash}
mkdir quality_summaries
cat filter | while read line;do cp final/$line\_busco/short_summary*$line\_busco.txt quality_summaries/$line\.txt;done
cd quality_summaries

grep "C:" *.txt > comp
sed -i 's/%/  /g' comp
cat comp | awk '{print $1, $2, $4}' > col
sed -i 's/C://g' col
sed -i 's/,D://g' col
sed -i 's/.txt://g' col

cat col | awk '$3<10' > duplication
cat col | awk '$2>90' > completeness

```

```{r}
N50 <- read.csv2('data/N50', sep = ' ', header = F)

N50 |> dplyr::right_join(redundance) |> dplyr::arrange(-N50)
```

```{r}
redundance_graph

clusters <- igraph::cluster_louvain(redundance_graph)
membership <- igraph::membership(clusters)

temp <- N50
colnames(temp) <- c('genome', 'N50')
# Merge N50 values with membership
membership_df <- data.frame(genome = names(membership), cluster = membership)
n50_df <- merge(membership_df, temp, by = "genome")

n50_df$cluster <- as.factor(n50_df$cluster)
n50_df <- n50_df |> dplyr::group_by(cluster) |> dplyr::arrange(-N50) |> dplyr::arrange(cluster)

final_redundance <- n50_df |> dplyr::group_by(cluster) |> dplyr::slice(1)
removable <- n50_df |> dplyr::anti_join(final_redundance)
removable$genome |> writeLines()
```

```{bash}
for i in ../analysis_stage/usearch/*; do echo processing $i; GENOME=$(basename $i .faa); ./usearch -usearch_global $i -db resistome.udb -top_hit_only -evalue 1.0e-05 -id 0.5 -query_cov 0.5 -target_cov 0.5 -userout $GENOME\.res -userfields query+target+id+evalue+qlo+qhi+tlo+thi+ql+tl+bits;done
```

```{r}

resistome <- read.csv('data/resistome', sep = '\t', header = F)

colnames(resistome) <- c("genome", "query", "gene_info", "id", "evalue", "qlo", "qhi", "tlo", "thi", "ql", "tl", "bits")
resistome$genome <- as.factor(resistome$genome)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
resistome <- resistome |>
  mutate(partes = str_split(gene_info, "\\|"),  # Divide a string pelo "|"
         gene = sapply(partes, function(x) if(length(x) >= 4) str_trim(str_split(x[4], "\\[")[[1]][1]) else NA) # Pega a 4ª parte e remove o que vem depois de "["
  ) |> select(-partes)

resistome <- resistome |> mutate(aro_value = str_extract(gene_info, "ARO:([0-9]+)"))
```

```{r}
resistome.matrix <- reshape2::dcast(resistome, resistome$genome~resistome$gene, drop = FALSE)

row.names(resistome.matrix) <- resistome.matrix$`resistome$genome`

resistome.matrix <- resistome.matrix[,-1]

resistome.matrix #mostra presença e quantidade

resistome.matrix.bin <- resistome.matrix

resistome.matrix.bin[resistome.matrix.bin > 0] <- 1 
```

```{r}
aro_categories <- read.table('data/aro_categories.tsv', sep = '\t', header = T)

aro_annotation <- resistome |> dplyr::left_join(aro_index, by = c('aro_value' = 'ARO Accession'))
```

### core-score (não faz sentido aqui)
```{r}
# Default 1000 replications of 20 genomes
core_score <- function(df, N=1000, sample_size=20){
  counter <- 0
  all_dfs <- list() 
  
  for(i in seq_len(N)){
    counter <- counter + 1
  
  if(counter %in% seq(0, N, 500)){
    print(paste(counter, " simulations have been processed at", Sys.time()))
  }
    
    df_sampled <- cbind(iteration=counter, dplyr::sample_n(df, sample_size, replace = F))
    
    all_dfs[[paste(counter)]] <- df_sampled
  
  }

big.data <- do.call(rbind, all_dfs)

#Calculating the core score
print("calculating the core score")

score_table <- reshape2::melt(big.data, id=c("iteration", "genome")) |>
  dplyr::filter(value >= 1) |>
  dplyr::group_by(iteration, variable) |>
  dplyr::mutate(abs_freq = sum(value),
                rel_freq = abs_freq/sample_size, #sample size
                category = ifelse(rel_freq >= 0.95, "core", "acc")) |> 
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::group_by(variable) |>
  dplyr::mutate(score = mean(category == "core"),
                status = ifelse(score >=0.90, "core", "acc")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(c("variable","score", "status")) |>
  dplyr::distinct(variable, .keep_all = T)

return(score_table)
}
```

```{r}
colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(unique_categories), "Set3")
names(colors) <- unique_categories
```

```{r}
annotation_vector <- setNames(aro_annotation$`Resistance Mechanism`, aro_annotation$gene)

annotation_df <- data.frame(Antibiotic_Category = annotation_vector[colnames(resistome.matrix.bin)])
rownames(annotation_df) <- colnames(resistome.matrix.bin)

```

```{r}
# Fazendo uma cópia temporária do data frame de anotações
ann_tmp <- annotation_df
colnames(ann_tmp)[colnames(ann_tmp) == "Antibiotic_Category"] <- "Action method"

# Garante que a coluna seja fator com níveis corretos
ann_tmp$`Action method` <- as.factor(ann_tmp$`Action method`)

# Ajusta o nome da lista de cores
colors_tmp <- colors
names(colors_tmp) <- levels(ann_tmp$`Action method`)

rownames(resistome.matrix.bin) <- rownames(resistome.matrix.bin) |> gsub(pattern = '.fna', replacement = '') |> gsub(pattern = 'Isolate_1', replacement = 'New Isolate A') |> gsub(pattern = 'Isolate_2', replacement = 'New Isolate B') |> gsub(pattern = 'Isolate_3', replacement = 'New Isolate C') |> gsub(pattern = 'Isolate_4', replacement = 'New Isolate D')

colnames(resistome.matrix.bin) <- colnames(resistome.matrix.bin) |> gsub(pattern = 'Pseudomonas aeruginosa soxR', replacement = 'soxR') |> gsub(pattern = 'Agrobacterium fabrum chloramphenicol acetyltransferase', replacement = 'CAT') 

rownames(ann_tmp) <- rownames(ann_tmp) |> gsub(pattern = 'Pseudomonas aeruginosa soxR', replacement = 'soxR') |> gsub(pattern = 'Agrobacterium fabrum chloramphenicol acetyltransferase', replacement = 'CAT') 

ann_tmp$gene <- rownames(ann_tmp)

ann_tmp_ordered <- ann_tmp[match(colnames(resistome.matrix.bin), ann_tmp$gene), ]

library(ComplexHeatmap)

# Crie um dataframe de anotação para as colunas do heatmap
column_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Category = ann_tmp_ordered$`Action method`,
  col = list(`Action method` = c(
    "antibiotic inactivation" = '#FDE725',  # Color for "antibiotic inactivation"
    "antibiotic efflux" = "#440658",      # Color for "antibiotic efflux"
    "antibiotic efflux;antibiotic target alteration" = "#2DB37C" # Color for the combined category (I've chosen purple, feel free to change)
  )),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

# --- 3. Criar o Heatmap Setorizado ---
library(colorRamp2)
# Ajuste a paleta de cores para o heatmap binário (0 e 1)
col_fun = colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("#F2F3F3", "#646465"))
# Crie o heatmap
ht_list <- Heatmap(
  resistome.matrix.bin,
  name = "Presença/Ausência", # Título da legenda de cor do heatmap
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE, # Disable default clustering
  row_order = my_custom_row_order,  
  cluster_columns = FALSE, # Não agrupa as colunas automaticamente, pois você quer setorizar
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  top_annotation = column_ha, # Adiciona a anotação de categoria no topo
  
  # Dividir o heatmap pelas categorias
  column_split = ann_tmp_ordered$`Action method`, # Divide as colunas com base na coluna 'Category'
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"), # Estilo dos títulos dos setores
  column_gap = unit(3, "mm"), # Espaçamento entre os setores
  
  # Adicionar um título geral ao heatmap, se desejar
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Gene Presente",
    at = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("Ausente", "Presente")
  )
)

# Desenhar o heatmap
draw(ht_list,
     heatmap_legend_side = "left", # Posição da legenda do heatmap
     annotation_legend_side = "right" # Posição da legenda das anotações
) #10/7

```

```{r}
gene_names <- str_extract(colnames(pg_promotion.matrix.bin), "^[^_]+")

pg_merged <- as.data.frame(
  sapply(unique(gene_names), function(g) {
    gene_cols <- which(gene_names == g)  # Pega índices das colunas do mesmo gene
    rowSums(pg_promotion.matrix.bin[, gene_cols, drop = FALSE]) > 0  # Converte para presença/ausência
  })
)

# 3. Ajustar os nomes das colunas
colnames(pg_merged) <- unique(gene_names)

# 4. Converter valores lógicos para 0 e 1
pg_merged <- as.data.frame(lapply(pg_merged, as.integer))

# 5. Adicionar os nomes dos genomas de volta
rownames(pg_merged) <- rownames(pg_promotion.matrix.bin)

```

```{r}
# --- 3. Criar o Heatmap Setorizado ---
library(colorRamp2)
# Ajuste a paleta de cores para o heatmap binário (0 e 1)
col_fun = colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("#F2F3F3", "#646465"))
# Crie o heatmap
ht_list <- Heatmap(
  pg_merged,
  name = "Presence/Absence", # Título da legenda de cor do heatmap
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE, # Disable default clustering
  row_order = my_custom_row_order,  
  cluster_columns = FALSE, # Não agrupa as colunas automaticamente, pois você quer setorizar
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  top_annotation = column_ha, # Adiciona a anotação de categoria no topo
  
  # Dividir o heatmap pelas categorias
  column_split = ann_tmp_ordered$Plant_Growth_class, # Divide as colunas com base na coluna 'Category'
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"), # Estilo dos títulos dos setores
  column_gap = unit(3, "mm"), # Espaçamento entre os setores
  
  # Adicionar um título geral ao heatmap, se desejar
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Gene Presente",
    at = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("Absent", "Present")
  )
)

# Desenhar o heatmap
draw(ht_list,
     heatmap_legend_side = "left", # Posição da legenda do heatmap
     annotation_legend_side = "right" # Posição da legenda das anotações
) #10/7

```

### Get graph metrics

```{r}
get_graph_metrics <- function(g, lwr=0.70, upr=1.0){
    
  graph_metrics_list <- list()
  
  for(i in seq(lwr, upr, by=0.01)){
    print(i)
    g_filtered <- igraph::delete.edges(g, which(igraph::E(g)$identity < i))
    g_components <- igraph::components(g_filtered)
    
    metrics <- data.frame(identity=i,
                          density=igraph::graph.density(g_filtered),
                          components=g_components$no,
                          components_higher_10=length(g_components$csize[g_components$csize>10]),
                          graph_size=igraph::gsize(g_filtered),
                          modularity=igraph::modularity(g_filtered, igraph::components(g_filtered)$membership),
                          transitivity=igraph::transitivity(g_filtered))
    
    graph_metrics_list[[paste(i)]] <- metrics
  }
  big.data <- do.call(rbind, graph_metrics_list)
  return(big.data)
}
```

```{r}
graph_metrics <- get_graph_metrics(grafo)

```

## Criar labels

```{r}
# Supondo que seu ID original do IQ-TREE seja o nome do vértice
vertex_data <- data.frame(
  id = V(g)$name,
  epithet = V(g)$ncbi_epithet,
  reference = V(g)$Reference
)

# Cria rótulo customizado com base nos atributos
vertex_data <- vertex_data %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      !is.na(reference) & reference == "Reference" ~ paste0(epithet, " [Ref]"),
      TRUE ~ epithet
    )
  )

write.table(vertex_data[, c("id", "label")],
            file = "tip_labels_map.tsv",
            quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            sep = "\t")

```

```{r}
communities <- igraph::membership(lp) |> as.data.frame() 
communities$V1 <- rownames(communities)
communities$Community <- communities$x
communities$x <- NULL

azo_metadados <- communities |> dplyr::left_join(azo_metadados)

write.csv2(azo_metadados, file = 'data/azo_metadados.csv', col.names = T, sep = '\t')
```
